points: Build on your existing Python proficiency by completing a Linux command-line tutorial and creating a small automation script to qualify for cloud development roles at Bytedance and AWS.
Bridge the gap in cloud infrastructure and containerization required by Sea Group and IBM by following an introductory Docker and Kubernetes tutorial to deploy a local Python microservice.
Prepare for systems architecture and design roles at GovTech and AWS by studying fundamental system design principles and documenting a simple three-tier web application architecture.
Develop familiarity with Agile methodologies and requirements gathering through a collaborative open-source project to meet the expectations for systems analyst roles at Accenture.
